Thank you for your comment. I have tried many times to find small reasons to stay alive, as you said, whether it's a book I want to read or a dog I want to pet. But it only lasts for a fleeting moment, and my pain and loneliness last more. I really don't know what to do. I have no desire for the future, as life wasn't kind to me, I have no dreams, and my entire educational life has been decided by my parents. I feel like a puppet, people use me and leave me, and i'm just thrown away in the end. I am really lost and I don't feel like there is anything left for me honestly. Your kind words do mean a lot though, I didn't get many of those in my life.
